name: telegram-factcheck-bot
description: A Telegram bot that summarizes conversations using OpenAI and stores messages in AWS S3.

scripts.logs: aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/lambda/FactCheckerBot-LambdaFunction --region us-east-1 --start-time $(node -e 'process.stdout.write(String(Date.now()-2*60*1000))') --query 'events[*].message' --output text | sed 's/^[0-9T:\.-]*Z[[:space:]]*[a-f0-9-]*[[:space:]]*[A-Z]*[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/\[ANALYTICS\] message_received:/📨 Message:/' | sed 's/\[ANALYTICS\] tool_usage:/🔧 Tool:/' | sed 's/\[SEND_MESSAGES\]/📤 Response/' | sed 's/\[TOOLS\] Tool result:/⚡ Result:/' | sed 's/\[TOOLS\]/⚡ Tools/' | sed 's/\[ERROR\]/❌ Error/' | sed 's/Received message/📨 New message/' | sed 's/Creating voice memo/🎤 Voice/' | sed 's/Audio generation/🔊 Audio/' | grep -E '📨|🔧|📤|⚡|❌|🎤|🔊|ERROR|Failed|Success|Loop [0-9]|reply|Tool result' | sed 's/\(⚡ Result:.*\)\(.\{100\}\).*/\1\2.../' | tail -15 && echo '--- LIVE ---' && while true; do aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/lambda/FactCheckerBot-LambdaFunction --region us-east-1 --start-time $(node -e 'process.stdout.write(String(Date.now()-15*1000))') --query 'events[*].message' --output text | sed 's/^[0-9T:\.-]*Z[[:space:]]*[a-f0-9-]*[[:space:]]*[A-Z]*[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/\[ANALYTICS\] message_received:/📨 Message:/' | sed 's/\[ANALYTICS\] tool_usage:/🔧 Tool:/' | sed 's/\[SEND_MESSAGES\]/📤 Response/' | sed 's/\[TOOLS\] Tool result:/⚡ Result:/' | sed 's/\[TOOLS\]/⚡ Tools/' | sed 's/\[ERROR\]/❌ Error/' | sed 's/Received message/📨 New message/' | sed 's/Creating voice memo/🎤 Voice/' | sed 's/Audio generation/🔊 Audio/' | grep -E '📨|🔧|📤|⚡|❌|🎤|🔊|ERROR|Failed|Success|Loop [0-9]|reply|Tool result' | sed 's/\(⚡ Result:.*\)\(.\{100\}\).*/\1\2.../' | tail -3; sleep 3; done
scripts.test:syntax: find . -name '*.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/tests/*' -exec node --check {} \; && echo 'All files are syntactically valid'
